title: Polski · RUPL v0.2
path_order_note: Path-54: full A1 canopy (48 live) + A2 begun 2026-08-04 (a2_past_byc, a2_weather live; rest of A2 draft spine planned, skipped by live walk). A2 decisions 2026-08-04: full both-gender past production; singular first (a2_past_plural split, after plural-Nom); imperfective-only until a2_aspect; interleave grammar+vocab; explain fields authored from A2 unit 1. B1 spine added 2026-08-05 (30 planned nodes, James-locked decisions in codex/B1-SPINE.md). B2 spine added 2026-08-06 (45 planned nodes, agent-authored defaults in codex/B2-SPINE.md; every design fork logged in its 'Open for James to overrule' section).

nodes.label: Czas · wczoraj i dawniej
nodes.note: Past time words: 10 chunks/adverbs riding a2_past_byc. Bare adverbs vs fixed w-phrases split into two blocks.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · -ać
nodes.note: Past of -ac/-owac verbs, singular both genders. One rule: infinitive minus c + l + person ending. Imperfective only.

nodes.label: Pogoda
nodes.note: Frames pack riding a2_past_byc: pada→padał pairs + 6 new words (zimno, mgła, burza, mróz, upał, pochmurno). Nouns/seasons recycled from a1_nature — NOT re-taught.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · reszta
nodes.note: Same past rule on -ic/-ec verbs + whole-form mialem/chcialem (e->a shift deliberately NOT explained until B1). Teaches infinitive miec (gap closed 2026-08-04).

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · trening
nodes.note: Gym: gender + person discrimination across all taught past forms. Zero new material. Wczoraj-framed.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · Jak było?
nodes.note: Chunk unit riding the past block: Jak bylo? / Co slychac? / Nic nowego. Teaches the adverb dobrze (real gap - course had only adjective dobry). Perfective "Jak minal weekend?" replaced 2026-08-05 with "Jak bylo w weekend?".

nodes.label: Uczucia i nastroje
nodes.note: Feelings riding past+adjective: Bylem zmeczony / Bylam smutna. 7 NEW adjectives only - a1_freetime already owned szczesliwy/smutny/zly and a1_trunk_adjectives owned zmeczony. Both genders on the board.

nodes.label: Liczba mnoga · -y/-i/-a/-e
nodes.note: Non-virile plural Nom/Acc (identical - taught as the gift). -y / -i after k,g / -e soft / neuter -a; adjectives always -e. k/g rule is the a1_gen_ki payoff. Suppletives + virile fenced.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · liczba mnoga
nodes.note: Plural past: -li = any group with a man, -ly = everything else. Byc + mieszkac + robic, all six persons. Teaches the conjunction "i" (and) - a real gap, nothing taught it before. Virile system stays B1.

nodes.label: Rodzina 2
nodes.note: 12 new family nouns incl. plural-only rodzice/dzieci (taught whole - both are irregular and fenced from plural_nom). Rides past_plural for 3 sentences.

nodes.label: Dopełniacz · liczba mnoga
nodes.note: Genitive plural, REGULAR ONLY: masc -ow, fem/neut zero-ending on non-shifting stems. Every vowel-shift and fleeting-e stem fenced, including pies->psow and samochod->samochodow (both dropped by the author as stem-changing - correct).

nodes.label: Stacja 1 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer (parked design): ending-cloze, cumulative A1+early-A2 bank, speed emphasis.

nodes.label: Liczby 5+ · dopełniacz
nodes.note: 2-4 + Nom pl, 5+ + Gen pl. Teaches dwie (fem two), dolary/dolarow, godziny/minuty, lata/lat. Ile masz lat? is the payoff. Teens (11-19) behave as 5+ - caught by the author, without it the age payoff induces *dwanascie lata.

nodes.label: Zakupy i pieniądze
nodes.note: SECOND layer of money vocab - all 14 original candidates were already owned by a1_shopping. 19 genuinely new: moneta, banknot, bankomat, konto, platnosc, kredyt, sprzedawca, koszyk, wozek, prezent, wydawac, zarabiac, oszczedzac, bogaty, biedny. zloty omitted (adjectival declension).

nodes.label: Rozmówki · w sklepie
nodes.note: Shop chunks. Instrumental karta/gotowka quarantined as frozen phrases - case never named. zaplacic -> placic (perfective ban). Poprosze kept as an opaque politeness word despite being formally perfective.

nodes.label: Narzędnik · z kimś
nodes.note: z + Instrumental for company. Same endings as a1_inst_job, second job. -a masculines (tata->tata, kolega->kolega) and k->-iem (wujek->wujkiem) taught. Plural inst, z mezem and z przyjacielem fenced.

nodes.label: Ludzie · wygląd i charakter
nodes.note: 11 new character/looks adjectives x both genders. TONE: brzydki/glupi/gruby/chudy/slaby deliberately never aimed at a named relative - weather, films, animals, a thick book, the speaker himself. Family sentences are all compliments.

nodes.label: Jechać · jadę czy idę?
nodes.note: jechac = go BY VEHICLE vs already-known ide = on foot. Endings are the -e/-esz class he owns; only the ja-/je- stem swap is new. Teaches the infinitive jechac (untaught before). isc deliberately left to a2_chodzic, so the contrast is live only at ja/ty - that unit must close it.

nodes.label: Narzędnik · czym jedziesz?
nodes.note: Bare instrumental of means - NO preposition. z+vehicle planted as a wrong choice in 7 of 12 quiz items so the English-interference error is repeatedly rejected. Third job of one case: identity, company, means. samochodem taught whole (o->o shift), auto->autem beside it as the shift-free case.

nodes.label: Podróż · logistyka
nodes.note: 11 new travel nouns + spozniony/spozniona. Two soft-ending gender traps taught explicitly: bagaz is m despite -z, podroz is f despite the consonant.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · droga
nodes.note: Street directions. "Jak dojsc do...?" DROPPED (dojsc perfective) and replaced with "Ktoredy do...?" which has no verb slot at all, so aspect cannot arise. isc carried as an opaque block, never named or conjugated. Ordinals dropped with the "first street on the left" function.

nodes.label: Wakacje
nodes.note: Holidays. wakacje turned out to be ALREADY taught by a1_freetime (recycled, not re-taught). gory is genuinely new (a1 taught only singular gora). Locative chunks na plazy / w gorach taught as forms since neither noun is usable without them.

nodes.label: Kraje i języki
nodes.note: Countries, nationalities, languages, aimed at an ENGLISH learner: Jestem Anglikiem / Nie mowie po polsku. Capitalisation taught as content via Polska vs polska ksiazka. Feminine nationalities included (Polka/Polka) because a1_inst_job already drilled the -ka/-ka slot. po polsku / po angielsku taught as opaque whole chunks, never analysed against the adjective polski. England tag-sequence flag emoji removed - does not render on Win10.

nodes.label: Iść czy chodzić?
nodes.note: Closes the isc grid a2_jechac left open (all six persons) + habitual chodzic. Now-vs-habit carried by teraz/codziennie, not grammar talk. Teaches codziennie (was untaught). jezdzic fenced, named nowhere.

nodes.label: Stacja 2 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer: past tense + plural + Inst in the bank.

nodes.label: Czasowniki z się
nodes.note: Verbs that travel with sie. Framed as a word belonging to the verb, NEVER as "self". Hook is Jak sie masz? (genuinely taught) - NOT nazywam sie, which turned out to be untaught anywhere. spotykac sie dropped: it governs z+Inst and would make this a two-system unit.

nodes.label: Dzień codzienny
nodes.note: Daily routine, built to a five-line connected day - the first paragraph-shaped thing he can say. sie verbs framed exactly as a2_sie: sie belongs to the verb, never "self", and the English glosses (wake up / have a wash / get dressed) carry no self either. Closes two real gaps: jem/jesz (present of jesc) and the infinitive wracac were taught nowhere.

nodes.label: Dom i meble
nodes.note: Home + furniture. Every locative verified individually: w kuchni / w sypialni / w lazience are NOT taught anywhere, so those rooms are left out of every sentence rather than sneaking the forms in (the biuro/biurze trap).

nodes.label: Czas przyszły · będę
nodes.note: Compound future bede + infinitive. Two gifts named explicitly: it is the same shape as moge+infinitive he already builds, and the future has NO gender after a whole block of bylem/bylam. Perfective future and bede pisal both fenced. Copular future (bede w domu) deliberately excluded - bede byc is not Polish.

nodes.label: Muszę · można · trzeba
nodes.note: musze + infinitive, plus the invariable impersonals mozna/trzeba framed as situation-not-person. Negation deliberately kept out entirely: nie musze and nie mozna both flip meaning and setting them against each other is past A2. warto dropped as load for no survival gain.

nodes.label: Praca 2
nodes.note: Employment only, kept strictly distinct from a2_school2 (zero shared lemmas). zwolnienie dropped as two-sense (dismissal / sick note) - premia took its slot. szukac anchored to szukam pracy.

nodes.label: Nauka
nodes.note: Studying only. zdac/oblac are PERFECTIVE and this node precedes a2_aspect, so they appear only as bare infinitives after moge/moze - never in the past, never after bedzie where a perfective infinitive would be ungrammatical. zadanie sits one letter from the taught zdanie; explain names that confusion directly.

nodes.label: Pary czasowników
nodes.note: Aspect named at last, PAST ONLY. Four twins (kupic/zrobic/wypic/przeczytac) taught as pairs to learn whole - NO prefix rule, because z-/wy-/prze-/nothing is genuinely unpredictable and a rule would be false. gotowac/ugotowac dropped: gotowac has no past form taught anywhere, so there was no imperfective to contrast against. Perfective FUTURE fenced absolutely - verified zero occurrences - so it cannot contradict a2_bedzie. Beginner fallback taught explicitly: when unsure use the imperfective, since the perfective adds the completion claim you can be wrong about.

nodes.label: Jedzenie 2 · restauracja
nodes.note: At the table: 12 new items incl. cutlery. Adjective feminines verified individually before use (slodka/slona/smaczna/goraca) - duza/mala/wysoka confirmed still untaught and avoided. gorzki rejected as a near-homograph of the taught comparative gorszy.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · restauracja
nodes.note: Restaurant chunks. The author found a real ordering constraint: a2_dat_chunks sits AFTER this node, so "Smakuje mi ta zupa" was dropped despite being in the pool - "It was delicious" is carried by Bylo bardzo smaczne instead. zamawiac family dropped (only the infinitive is taught). pan/pani used as two opaque whole questions with one line of orientation, no declension; plus a free escape route "Co jest dobre?" using zero new words so he always has a version he can produce under pressure. Table-for-two dropped entirely (dla is not even taught).

nodes.label: Mi się podoba
nodes.note: Dative PRONOUN CHUNKS only - the case is never named anywhere, no ci/mu/jej, no paradigm. The subject-flip is the whole unit: the film does the pleasing, the coffee does the tasting. Made actionable by forcing "Smakuje mi ta kawa" (nominative) against the known "chce kawe". daj mi dropped: imperative is a new system AND it is the one chunk that does not show the flip.

nodes.label: Zdrowie 2 · boli mnie
nodes.note: Pharmacy + doctor. 6 of 14 candidates turned out already taught (incl. plecy, owned by a1_body). Teaches bola so "Bola mnie plecy" works - a deliberate ONE-crack exception to the plural fence a2_dat_chunks set, inside the frozen block only, no paradigm. The -enie neuter pattern (badanie/szczepienie/ubezpieczenie/cisnienie) flagged so the gender is one fact not four.

nodes.label: Stacja 3 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer: aspect pairs + dative chunks in bank.

nodes.label: O czym mówisz?
nodes.note: o + Locative for topic - same case and endings as w/na, third governor. Consolidation slide sets all three preposition families side by side (w/na=where, do/z=direction, o=topic). Teaches myslec (untaught before); its PAST is fenced (e->a shift). Pronoun objects o tobie/o mnie deferred to their own unit.

nodes.label: Internet i telefon
nodes.note: Internet + phone, 13 new items. All three new verbs land in conjugation classes already taught, so no new pattern. myszka needed a sense indicator because mysz is already taught as the animal. strona confirmed already taught; haslo genuinely new.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · telefon i SMS
nodes.note: Phone chunks. oddzwonie (perfective future) not substituted but REMOVED - the future left the unit entirely, since any perfective-present-shaped future would contradict a2_bedzie. Do uslyszenia carries the goodbye instead: a frozen do-phrase parallel to the taught do widzenia / do zobaczenia, with no verb in it, so aspect never arises. Imperative "Napisz mi SMS" dropped outright (doubly illegal: imperative unit is 6 nodes later AND perfective).

nodes.label: Która godzina?
nodes.note: Ordinals 6th-12th (a1_numbers already owned 1st-5th) + clock as FROZEN chunks. The -ej forms are never put beside their ordinal number-for-number and no locative id is tagged, so the case cannot be induced. Half-past/quarter deliberately absent. KNOWN GAP: teaches asking the time and saying WHEN things happen, but not saying the hour back (Jest trzecia) - that is a third inflected set and wants its own small unit.

nodes.label: Święta i daty
nodes.note: Celebrations. urodziny turned out NOT taught (brief was wrong) so it is taught here. karta is taken by the bank card, so kartka is used with an explain naming the contrast. Dates avoided entirely - locative months (w maju) are not taught anywhere, verified. Plural-only block (urodziny/zyczenia/gratulacje) mirrors a2_family2; agreement load split so no sentence stacks adjective agreement and plural verb at once.

nodes.label: Naj- · stopniowanie 2
nodes.note: naj- on the inherited comparative set + od+Gen, the comparison a1_comparatives explicitly deferred. HOMOGRAPH DISCIPLINE: od mamy/taty/siostry/corki/wina/gazety all REFUSED - mamy is taught only as the verb "we have", the rest only as nominative plurals, so each would have passed a string-matching audit while showing a form the learner reads as something else. matki (a real taught genitive) carries the family slot instead. niz/od framed as a free choice and made structurally true: 7 of 12 Uzycie items accept both.

nodes.label: Natura · wycieczki
nodes.note: Nature and days out. jezdzic fence held (a2_chodzic reserves it). AUTHORED BUT NOT AGENT-REPORTED (agent died mid-stream); verified independently by the orchestrator - pool-checked position-aware, no re-teaching, gender badges correct.

nodes.label: Sport i hobby
nodes.note: Sport spectating + exercise. siłownia/drużyna/ćwiczyć confirmed already taught (a1_freetime), dropped. jeździć fenced and confirmed absent - a stale draft note on this very node had listed "jeździć na rowerze" as a candidate, which the author caught and ignored. wygrywać/przegrywać kept present-tense only - their real past-tense use is perfective (wygrać/przegrać), fenced to a2_aspect.

nodes.label: Tryb rozkazujący · chunki
nodes.note: Imperative as a CLOSED CHUNK SET, never a rule - czekaj/sluchaj/idz/chodz/daj learned whole, formation never explained. Plus the polite escape hatch prosze + infinitive, which needs no imperative morphology at all. Negative imperatives, niech pan and 1pl all fenced. AUTHORED BUT NOT AGENT-REPORTED (agent died mid-stream); verified independently by the orchestrator.

nodes.label: Pytania 2 · dlaczego, który
nodes.note: Second question wave: dlaczego/bo paired, kiedy, ile (recycled, already taught), ktory/ktora/ktore Nominative ONLY. Oblique forms (ktorego/ktorej/ktorym) absent as fenced - the one "ktorej" hit is the already-taught frozen clock chunk "o ktorej" from a2_ordinals_time, used legitimately to contrast kiedy (general time) against a fixed hour, not a new case form.

nodes.label: Przypadki · trening 2
nodes.note: A2 automaticity gym. Zero new material, mixed Nom/Acc/Gen-sg/Loc-sg/Inst-sg/Nom-pl/Gen-pl discrimination. Homograph traps checked individually - gazety/wina/okna/córki (nom-pl only) never used as correct answers; the one "gazety" appearance is a wrong-choice distractor for the item whose real answer is the taught genitive plural "gazet". domu and banku/parku dual-duty (genitive AND locative, both genuinely taught) named explicitly for the learner.

nodes.label: Przyimki · powtórka A2
nodes.note: A2 preposition/case review, zero new material. Forces real choice by putting w/na/do/z/o all on the SAME noun (biuro: w biurze/do biura/z biura/o biurze). z+Inst (company) vs bare Inst (transport) drilled as the highest-value trap named in both source units own notes. Countries and restauracja/kawiarnia dropped - both genuinely untaught in those forms, confirmed by the owning packs own notes. FIX APPLIED: agent had put all 15 recombined phrases in teaches_lemmas despite its own report admitting every one was already taught verbatim elsewhere - moved to uses_lemmas, which is what a review unit should actually declare.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · powtórka
nodes.note: A2 CAPSTONE. Recombines all five Situations units (shop, directions, restaurant, phone, smalltalk) into mixed scenes forcing choice between confusable chunks, not just recall in isolation - Nie wiem/Nie slysze/Nic nowego, Wszystko w porzadku/To wszystko dziekuje, To zly numer/To daleko/To blisko. Closes with a nine-chunk one-day sentence chaining shop->directions->restaurant->phone. teaches_lemmas empty by design - verified with an independent token-level sweep of every answer field against the pool, zero unresolved words (unlike the two units before it, both of which had real tagging bugs the orchestrator had to fix).

nodes.label: Stacja 4 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer: full A1+A2 cumulative bank. Exit velocity check.

nodes.label: Czas przyszły dokonany
nodes.note: FIRST B1 UNIT. The four taught twins get their future (24 forms, plural included - no gender, so the load is fair; kupicie/wypijecie/przeczytasz/przeczytaja intro-table-only but tagged). THE AMENDMENT: slide 1 honestly updates a2_bedzie one-future claim before any new form appears; bede kupowac appears ONLY there, verified. Which-future-when is explicitly deferred to b1_two_futures. The kupie-does-NOT-copy-kupuje trap gets its own slide.

nodes.label: Dwa czasy przyszłe
nodes.note: Pure discrimination between the two owned futures, decided by taught time words. Delivers exactly the promise b1_perf_future made. Beginner fallback carried over from a2_aspect: when unsure, bede+verb is never wrong grammar. caly checked untaught and dropped from the caveat example.

nodes.label: Plany
nodes.note: Plans register riding the new future. Perfective trio (obiecac/zalatwic/umowic sie) held to the zdac/oblac precedent: bare infinitives after moge/musze/chce only. Orchestrator applied the agents own offered fix: "Musze to zalatwic" -> "Musze zalatwic bilet" (to-as-object-pronoun was an untaught function).

nodes.label: Siłownia · aspekt
nodes.note: The full four-way grid: kupowalem/kupilem/bede kupowac/kupie, drilled with time-word and result cues. Zero new material, all 120 distinct tokens pool-verified, every untaught person-form explicitly avoided.

nodes.label: Chciałbym · tryb przypuszczający
nodes.note: Conditional SINGULAR (James decision #3). 14 forms on three verbs (chciec/kupic/zrobic). Politeness payoff: Chce kawe -> Chcialbym kawe, same sentence one register up. 2sg conditionals grounded on taught 3sg stem + byles ending - the honest morphological decomposition, since chciales/kupilas were never taught. Plural conditional: zero forms, zero mentions.

nodes.label: Uprzejmość · zwroty
nodes.note: Politeness register riding the fresh conditional. moglby/moglaby exist only inside two whole opening questions, never derived from moge. Sharp homograph call: "Poprosze o..." DROPPED because o is taught AS the locative governor - an o+Acc frame would be a live trap on a function word he owns; plain Poprosze+noun already does the job.

nodes.label: Szedłem · przeszłość iść
nodes.note: The course first suppletive past: szedlem/szlam etc, 7 forms taught WHOLE in the mialem lineage. Stem split (szed-/sz-) = table fact, no rule, no historical morphology. Payoff promised but no prefixed form named anywhere, note included. MUST precede b1_arrive_leave.

nodes.label: Przyjść · wyjść
nodes.note: The szedl-payoff kept: przyszedlem/wyszedlem mirror the just-learned stems ("not one letter changed behind it"). Bonus find: przyjsc was already taught in A1 trunk_can (Moge przyjsc jutro) - recycled, honestly told to the learner. 43 forms; futures held to 3 singular persons (load call, logged). wyjechac-do withheld to keep przy-=do / wy-=z clean on first contact.

nodes.label: W drodze
nodes.note: Journey-as-narrative register. zgubic call DEVIATED from zdac/oblac precedent with sound reasoning: perfective past morphology is owned since a2_aspect, so zgubilem/spoznilem sie taught as tagged wholes. Verified: zero perfective futures of the new verbs. First background-imperfective + event-perfective sentence in the course: Szedlem do domu i po drodze kupilem chleb.

nodes.label: Ci czy te? · rozpoznawanie
nodes.note: B1 SPINE block 4, unit 1/3 (James decision #1). RECOGNITION ONLY: ci vs te, plus six whole virile plural nouns + dobrzy, handed over with no formation rule. type_items/use_items intentionally empty (zero production, per spine text) — see pack note for the engine trace confirming this ladders cleanly to Wstep-Kontrola-Done and still earns fruit. Production rule = b1_virile_nom (next). oni/one stay untaught until b1_virile_past — neither appears here.

nodes.label: Studenci, Polacy… · mianownik
nodes.note: B1 SPINE block 4, unit 2/3. PRODUCTION of virile Nom plural, REGULAR consonant sets only: -t->-ci, -k->-cy, already-soft->+e (student->studenci, Polak->Polacy, lekarz->lekarze). r->rz (kelnerzy) and all true irregulars (brat->bracia, kolega->koledzy, mezczyzna->mezczyzni, the -owie family) fenced out, logged in pack note. oni/one still untaught until b1_virile_past.

nodes.label: Oni byli · one były
nodes.note: B1 SPINE block 4, unit 3/3 (closes the virile block). Teaches oni/one at last (fenced everywhere before this node) and applies the already-taught -li/-ly rule to real virile-noun subjects (ci studenci, ci lekarze) vs non-virile ones (te kobiety, te domy) instead of a2_past_plural's 'name i name' workaround. One new verb spread to the plural past to match the spine's own example: pracowali/pracowaly.

nodes.label: Ludzie
nodes.note: Five new profession pairs (m/f), all inside the regular virile-nom rule and the a2 non-virile plural rule already taught, plus ludzie (people) handed over whole as the one closed irregular. dzieci deliberately not added alongside it — logged in the pack note.

nodes.label: Siłownia · oni/one
nodes.note: Zero new material. Closes the virile block (reco -> nom -> past -> people) with one mixed discrimination pass: ci/te, byli-pracowali/były-pracowały, oni/one are all the same 'at least one man?' test, drilled together.

nodes.label: Chcielibyśmy
nodes.note: [B1 SPINE, James decision #3] Plural conditional, closing block 4. No new rule: by attaches to the plural L-form (chcieli/chciały, kupili/kupiły, zrobili/zrobiły) exactly as it attached to the singular one in b1_conditional_sg, with the my/wy endings already owned from byliśmy/byłyście. The virile/non-virile choice is the same test from b1_virile_past, now asked of a would. chcieć full paradigm (payoff verb) + kupić/zrobić partial spread, 20 teaches_lemmas (14 conditional forms + 6 bare plural-past stems shown as the stepping stone).

nodes.label: Stacja B1 · 1
nodes.note: [B1 SPINE] PLACEHOLDER - bank authored when block live; engine future work.

nodes.label: Celownik
nodes.note: [B1 SPINE] Noun datives singular with pomagać/dziękować (both riding already-owned present classes). Regular masc -owi (studentowi, nauczycielowi) taught as a real rule; mamie/tacie/bratu/siostrze handed over as four memorized whole forms, NOT a derived feminine rule (fenced — logged open question for James, see pack note). dawać deferred to b1_giving, logged. The A2 mi/mnie chunks finally explained as a case doing a job.

nodes.label: Mi · ci · mu · jej
nodes.note: [B1 SPINE] Completes the pronoun set A2 fenced: ci/mu/jej/nam/wam/im (virile block is live, so nam/wam/im are path-legal). podoba ci się payoff, full podobać się paradigm + partial smakować. boleć deliberately excluded (accusative-governing, different pronoun set). Homograph: ci re-teaches the string already taught as the virile demonstrative in b1_virile_reco — disambiguated explicitly in the pack, see its note.

nodes.label: Dawanie i pomaganie
nodes.note: The vocab payoff of the dative block: dawać (full 6-form, the verb b1_dative_sg deferred here), oddawać and pożyczać (partial spreads) — all riding already-taught present classes (present_e_esz, present_am), zero new structures. Every recipient/object recycled from b1_dative_sg/b1_dative_pron/A1-A2. prosić o deliberately NOT included (would need a new o+Accusative structure distinct from the taught o+Locative o_loc) — logged as open question for James in the pack note.

nodes.label: Który · przez przypadki
nodes.note: który stops being just the a2_questions2 interrogative and becomes a real relative pronoun: Accusative (książka, którą czytałem — case set by the known transitive verb inside the clause) and Genitive (film, którego nie ma — case set by the known nie ma pattern). Inanimate/abstract antecedents only this unit — masculine-animate relatives (Acc=Gen merge) deferred, logged as open question for James. Homograph: której was already a frozen a2_ordinals_time chunk (o której? = at what time) — re-taught here as a real, productive case form, same treatment b1_dative_sg gave dziękuję.

nodes.label: Żeby
nodes.note: Two uses of żeby, taught together since both ride owned material with zero new endings: purpose (żeby + bare infinitive) and want-that (żebym/żebyś/żeby, singular only, + the bare L-form verb — the same person-marker family as conditional bym/byś/by, attached to żeby instead of the verb). Every want-that example keeps the wanter and the doer as different people, since self-wanting doesn't use żeby in Polish. Plural żeby-forms deliberately deferred, logged as open question for James.

nodes.label: Opowiadanie
nodes.note: Narrative connectives (najpierw, potem, w koncu, nagle, niestety, na szczescie) — zero new structures, every example sentence recycles past tense/aspect/motion/virile material already live. This is the unit that unlocks telling a story in the past.

nodes.label: Co się stało?
nodes.note: Situations unit: recombines najpierw/potem/w koncu/nagle/niestety/na szczescie with already-taught past/aspect/motion/virile material into short narratives. Teaches one small new closed chunk set on the opaque form stalo: Co sie stalo? / Cos sie stalo. / Nic sie nie stalo. — never conjugated as a verb, same chunk-lane treatment as nie slysze.

nodes.label: Kupuj czy kup?
nodes.note: The formation rule A2 withheld: 3sg present (or, for perfective verbs, future) minus its ending, +j if vowel-final, bare if consonant-final. Retroactively explains 4 of A2's 5 chunk imperatives. Negative imperative = nie + IMPERFECTIVE always, demonstrated with the kupic/kupowac and wypic/pic aspect pairs. robic->rob (o->o with acute shift) fenced out entirely, including from learner-facing content.

nodes.label: Szybciej · lepiej
nodes.note: Comparison of ADVERBS (fenced out of a2_superlatives). Adjectives compare with -y/-a/-e agreement; adverbs compare as one invariant word. szybko->szybciej->najszybciej (regular -o->-iej), dobrze->lepiej->najlepiej and duzo->wiecej->najwiecej (irregular, bases already taught), mało->mniej->najmniej (added beyond the spine three to reach a clean 12-row Match board, zero new grammar). od+Gen and niz both recycle unchanged from a2_superlatives.

nodes.label: Mamo! Tato!
nodes.note: Vocative stays CHUNK-LANE ONLY (James decision #4) - never taught as a case, no endings rule anywhere. Six frozen calling-forms: Mamo!/Tato!/Babciu!/Dziadku! (family) plus two formal panie/pani+name chunks named in the spine itself, Panie Piotrze!/Pani Anno! (piotr/anna already glue names). Name-vocative pattern NOT generalised beyond these two named examples.

nodes.label: Opinie
nodes.note: Opinion register: moim zdaniem, zgadzac sie / nie zgadzac sie, miec racje, na pewno, and a re-taught moze (maybe) — HOMOGRAPH flagged loudly against trunk_can_a1s moze (he can). Zero new structures; sentences deliberately recycle a wide spread including b1_adverb_comp and b1_vocative_chunks, the two units immediately before this one on the path.

nodes.label: Siłownia · wszystko
nodes.note: Zero-new-material discrimination gym. Extends a2_case_gym2's seven-job case grid with the four systems B1 added: Dative-noun (b1_dative_sg), Dative-pronoun (b1_dative_pron), virile Nominative (b1_virile_reco/nom), virile past (b1_virile_past). Title changed from placeholder 'wszystkie przypadki' (both words untaught) to 'wszystko' (taught, a2_smalltalk).

nodes.label: Jeden dzień · koniec
nodes.note: B1 CAPSTONE, genre of a2_wrapup_func. Zero-new recombination of four registers named in this node's original spine note: plans (b1_plans), politeness (b1_polite), narrative (b1_stories + b1_journeys), opinions (b1_opinions). Title changed from placeholder using the raw level code 'B1' to 'Jeden dzień, koniec' (both words taught) since a level code is not learner Polish vocabulary.

nodes.label: Stacja B1 · 2
nodes.note: [B1 SPINE] PLACEHOLDER - end-of-level exit-velocity bank.

nodes.label: Ale, a, więc
nodes.note: First unit of B2. Seven invariable words the course never taught, all verified NEW: four joiners (ale, a, więc, albo) and three in-sentence particles (też, już, jeszcze). Zero morphology — none of them ever changes shape. The one teaching point, given its own slide and table, is i / a / ale: English collapses all three into and/but, Polish splits them by how the two halves relate. i (a2_past_plural) and bo (a2_questions2) are already-owned anchors, recycled as distractors, never re-taught. Two conservative scope cuts logged in the pack note: dlatego is left out (its partner dlatego że is on the C1 subordination list), and the negative-polarity readings już nie / jeszcze nie are fenced completely, since each flips its word's meaning rather than extending it.

nodes.label: Będę w domu
nodes.label_en: I will be… · future of być
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 1, unit 2. Pays a2_bedzie's explicitly accepted gap: 'the COPULAR future is NOT taught... consequence, accepted: I will be at home is not yet expressible.' ZERO new forms - bede..beda are owned, every place phrase and predicate adjective is owned. The whole unit is the syntactic fact that byc's future takes no infinitive after it. Cheapest high-value unit in B2.

nodes.label: Mamie, szkole, pracy
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 1, unit 3. PAYS B1-DIGEST DEFERRED ITEM 1: the general feminine Dative/Locative rule b1_dative_sg refused to derive ('stays untaught - James should decide whether it needs a slot'). Feminine -a -> -e with stem softening (mama/mamie, siostra/siostrze, szkola/szkole, kobieta/kobiecie) plus the -i sub-class after a soft stem (kuchnia/kuchni, praca/pracy). THE GIFT, stated openly: Dative and Locative are the same form for feminine nouns, so one rule pays for two cases. Anchors already taught on both sides: szkole/pracy (Loc, a1_prep_place), mamie/siostrze/tacie (Dat, b1_dative_sg). Verified NEW and available: kuchni, sypialni, lazience, ulicy.

nodes.label: Dobrą kawę · biernik
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 1 of 6 (spine O2 - the adjective case system, split so no unit adds more than two endings). NO NEW ENDINGS: feminine -a is already taught (dobra, nowa, a1_miec: Mam dobra kawe) and is generalised to more adjectives; masculine-inanimate and neuter are unchanged from the Nominative, which is the relief slide. FENCED: masculine-ANIMATE (dobrego psa) waits for b2_adj_gen, where -ego is actually taught. Also fenced, per the spine's standing fence: -ego/-ym/-emu must not appear anywhere in this unit, not even as a distractor.

nodes.label: Dobrego, dobrej · dopełniacz
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 2 of 6. Teaches -ego (m/n) and -ej (f) - one paradigm row. Payoffs on owned governors only: nie ma dobrej kawy (negation), do duzego sklepu (prep_do_gen), duzo zimnej wody (a1_gen_endings). Masculine-animate Accusative folds in here as the honest Acc=Gen exception AGENTS.md names. TRAP, flagged in advance (spine O16): check_new.py reports 'nowego' as TAUGHT - it is frozen inside a2_smalltalk's chunk 'nic nowego' and the learner has never been shown it as a genitive adjective. Treat as a chunk-to-paradigm re-teach, the dziekuje/ktorej precedent.

nodes.label: Praca i biuro
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2 vocab interleave (so the adjective block is not six grammar units in a row). Work & office register. Verified NEW via check_new.py: wynagrodzenie, zwolnienie, nadgodziny, obowiazek, stanowisko, podanie, rozmowa, zatrudnienie, wyksztalcenie, kwalifikacje, etat, raport. ANCHORS, never re-taught (all verified TAUGHT): umowa/awans/premia/pracodawca/doswiadczenie (a2_work2), pensja/firma/szef/pracownik/biuro/spotkanie/kariera (leaf_work_a1), zarabiac (a2_shopping2).

nodes.label: W nowej pracy · miejscownik
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 3 of 6. -ym (m/n) is the one new ending; -ej (f) recycles from b2_adj_gen one unit earlier. Rides all three Locative governors already owned: w/na (prep_w_loc) and o (o_loc). W nowej pracy. Mysle o dobrym filmie.

nodes.label: Dobrym nauczycielem · narzędnik
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 4 of 6. NO NEW ENDINGS - -ym recycles from Locative, -a from Accusative. The course's signature 'same endings, another job' unit; this is the fourth turn of the pattern that runs inst_identity -> inst_z -> inst_transport. Jestem dobrym nauczycielem. Jade z mila siostra. Jade nowym autobusem.

nodes.label: Dobremu · celownik
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 5 of 6. -emu (m/n) is the one new ending; -ej (f) recycles for the third time. Small by design. Rides pomagac/dawac/dziekowac from B1's dative block.

nodes.label: Siłownia · dobry
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 2, unit 6 of 6. Gym idiom (a1_case_gym / a2_case_gym2 / b1_case_gym line): ZERO new material, teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both empty. Six-way adjective-case discrimination on one or two adjectives across many already-taught nouns.

nodes.label: Mnie, cię, go
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 3, unit 1. Accusative personal pronouns: mnie, cie, go, ja, nas, was, ich (all verified NEW except mnie). THE PAYOFF IS AN IOU THREE LEVELS OLD: a2_dat_chunks taught 'boli mnie' and its own note says 'mnie in boli mnie is accusative, not dative - deliberately NOT explained.' This unit explains it. Second half is a CONTRAST with the Dative set b1_dative_pron already owns (mi/ci/mu/jej) - a contrast, not new material. AUDITOR BLIND SPOT: person pronouns sit in audit.py's GLUE_LEMMAS, so no pronoun fence in B2 is machine-enforced; it is author discipline only.

nodes.label: O nim, z nią
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 3, unit 2. The n- forms after prepositions: o nim, o niej, z nim, z nia, do niego, dla niej (nim, niej, nich, nimi all verified NEW). Pays a2_o_loc's named fence: 'pronoun objects - o tobie, o mnie, o nim, o niej are new pronoun forms, absent from POOL... They need their own small unit.' Each preposition reuses its already-taught case; only the pronoun shape is new.

nodes.label: Z kim? O czym?
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 3, unit 3. The oblique question words: kim, czym, kogo, czego, komu (all verified NEW). Pays two named fences at once - a2_inst_z's ('kim is a new pronoun form and is not in POOL... if James wants Z kim? as a live question it needs its own small unit', the fence behind one of AGENTS.md's three title-rule violations) and a2_o_loc's (o czym kept out of every slide and out of body_pl too). Deliberately small.

nodes.label: Przychodnia i szpital
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 3 vocab. The health SYSTEM register - navigating care, not body parts (a1_body/a1_health/a2_health2 own those). Verified NEW: skierowanie, leczenie, objaw, diagnoza, oddzial, pogotowie, zabieg, operacja, specjalista, rejestracja, wyniki, izba. ANCHORS, never re-taught: karetka (leaf_health_a1), ubezpieczenie (a2_health2), kolejka (leaf_shopping_a1).

nodes.label: Stacja B2 · 1
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] PLACEHOLDER - rep bank. Stays 'planned' forever, same as A2's four stations and B1's two. Never authored, never flipped live.

nodes.label: Wiem, że…
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 1. ze as a productive complement conjunction: Wiem, ze... / Mysle, ze... / Mowil, ze... Rides wiem (a2_directions_func), mysle (a2_o_loc), mowil/mowila (a2_past_rest) - all owned, so the only new thing is the joint. TRAP, flagged in advance (spine O16): check_new.py reports 'ze' as TAUGHT, from b1_polite - but it is frozen inside 'Przepraszam, ze przeszkadzam' and that pack's own note says ze was verified untaught and never built. Re-teach explicitly, dziekuje/ktorej precedent, and say so on the slide. Also teaches the comma Polish requires and English does not - one line, one fact.

nodes.label: Mówił, że…
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 2. ONE new fact, and it is a relief: Polish does not back-shift the tense. 'Jestem zmeczony' -> Powiedzial, ze JEST zmeczony. Framed like a2_bedzie's 'the future has no gender' gift. mowil/mowila (owned) carry the unit; powiedzial/powiedziala (NEW) taught here as the perfective twin, whole, per the spine's closed-list treatment of aspect pairs (O7.2) - no prefix rule.

nodes.label: Nie wiem, gdzie…
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 3. Pays a2_questions2's own fence, named there and never built: 'no indirect questions (Nie wiem, kiedy... is B1)'. Nie wiem, gdzie on mieszka. Nie wiem, czy... Every question word is already owned (gdzie, kiedy, ile, czy, dlaczego, ktory); czy doing double duty as 'whether' is the one new job and is named as such.

nodes.label: Z którym? O którym?
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 4. PAYS B1-DIGEST DEFERRED ITEM 2, both halves. (a) Locative and Instrumental relatives (film, o ktorym mowilem; kolega, z ktorym pracuje) - b1_ktory_cases fenced these completely and logged 'deferred to a later pass or a dedicated unit'. (b) Masculine-ANIMATE antecedents (pies, ktorego mam) - fenced there because ktorego would sit in the Accusative table for a different reason than in the Genitive table; that objection dissolves once b2_adj_gen has taught Acc=Gen for masculine animates as a general fact, which is why this node sits after the adjective block.

nodes.label: Powód i cel
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4 vocab. Abstract-discussion nouns - the vocabulary opinions actually need. Verified NEW: przyczyna, skutek, wplyw, zmiana, rozwiazanie, korzysc, wada, zaleta, cel, sposob, wartosc, mozliwosc, wybor, decyzja, spoleczenstwo, srodowisko. TRIM TO 12 - the list is deliberately longer than the unit needs so the author can drop any word whose oblique forms would cost extra. ANCHORS: powod/sytuacja/przyszlosc/przeszlosc (leaf_ideas_a1), problem/przyklad/znaczenie (leaf_school_a1), all of b1_opinions.

nodes.label: Jeśli…
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 5. Real conditions: jesli + present/future (jesli verified NEW). Jesli bedzie ladna pogoda, bede w parku. Zero new morphology - both halves are tenses the learner owns, and b2_copular_future back in Block 1 is what makes the natural main clause expressible.

nodes.label: Gdybym miał czas…
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 4, unit 6. Unreal conditions: gdybym/gdybys/gdyby + L-form, main clause in the conditional. Pays b1_conditional_sg's named fence ('no gdybym/jesli...by clauses - simple wishes and soft requests only'). The person marker on gdyby is the IDENTICAL -m/-s/zero family already owned twice over (bym/bys/by from the conditional units, zebym/zebys from b1_zeby) - say so; it is the third turn of one pattern, not a new one.

nodes.label: W domach, w sklepach
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 1. Locative plural -ach: one ending, no gender split, essentially no exceptions - the easiest unit in B2 and placed first in the block for that reason. ANCHOR: 'w gorach' is already taught whole (a2_travel), so the unit can open with 'you have been saying one of these since A2.'

nodes.label: Z rodzicami
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 2. Instrumental plural -ami. Pays a2_inst_z's named fence ('plural instrumental (z rodzicami, z dziecmi) - B1, different ending set'). rodzicami verified NEW; rodzice owned from a2_family2. dziecmi/ludzmi are irregular - taught whole or fenced, author's conservative call, to be logged in the pack note.

nodes.label: Studentom, rodzicom
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 3. Dative plural -om. One ending. Rides B1's dative verbs (pomagac, dziekowac, dawac). Deliberately small - spine O9 kept the three plural obliques as three one-ending units rather than one three-ending cliff.

nodes.label: Szkół, książek, okien
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 4. Opens what a2_gen_pl fenced, as CLOSED FAMILIES OF WHOLE FORMS, not a productive rule (spine O10): vowel-shift (szkol), fleeting-e (ksiazek, okien), soft-stem masculines. All verified NEW. Every noun used must already be owned in the Nominative plural. The kelnerzy/moglby/family-datives treatment - never asked to apply it to an unseen noun.

nodes.label: Pięć osób było
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 5. A 5+ numeral phrase as grammatical SUBJECT takes a neuter-singular verb (Piec osob bylo w sklepie). This is a2_numbers_gen's own deferral, in its own words: '5+ phrases never stand as the subject of a verb in this pack, because that would need the neuter-singular agreement rule (B1)' - never built. NOTE (spine O8): the routine brief's claim that 'piec piw Gen-pl' is still deferred is out of date - a2_numbers_gen teaches it and piec piw is one of its own frames. This unit and b2_num_virile are what actually remained.

nodes.label: Pięciu studentów
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 6. Virile numerals: pieciu studentow, dwoch lekarzy (pieciu, wielu, osob all verified NEW). a2_numbers_gen's other deferral: 'NO PEOPLE-COUNTING anywhere - virile numerals (pieciu) are B1.' Sits deep in B2 because it needs the whole virile block (B1) AND Gen-pl completion. Closed set of numerals only; no derivation rule.

nodes.label: Siłownia · domy i ludzie
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 5, unit 7. Gym idiom: ZERO new material, teaches_* empty. All seven plural jobs the learner now owns - Nom, Acc, Gen, Loc, Inst, Dat, virile Nom - in one discrimination board.

nodes.label: Nie kupiłem chleba
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 1. The genitive of negation, generalised past 'nie mam'. a1_negation taught nie mam kawy as a fact about miec; it is a fact about EVERY negated transitive verb (Nie kupilem chleba. Nie widze kawy.). One rule extension, high frequency, and it names a pattern the learner has already met without a name. NOTE: chleba is verified NEW - chleb is one of the real-world exceptions to this course's simplified masculine-genitive rule, already caught once in b1_imperative_rule; teach the form or pick another noun.

nodes.label: Nikt nie wie
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 2. ADDED BEYOND THE ROUTINE BRIEF'S LIST, logged as an addition rather than a silent guess (spine O13, the na szczescie / nie zgadzac sie / malo precedent). Obligatory double negation: nikt, nigdzie, zaden (all verified NEW) with an obligatory second nie on the verb - Nikt nie wie. Nigdzie nie ide. nic and nigdy are already owned and are the anchors, so the learner has half the set and none of the syntax. English speakers get this wrong permanently unless it is named.

nodes.label: Jak się mówi?
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 3. Impersonal sie: Jak sie mowi po polsku? Tu sie nie pali. Mowi sie, ze... Extends a2_sie's framing (sie is a word that BELONGS to the verb, never 'self') to a construction with no subject at all. Verb always 3sg. Big functional payoff for someone reading signs.

nodes.label: Proszę o kawę
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 4. PAYS B1-DIGEST DEFERRED ITEM 3 (spine O11). prosic o + ACCUSATIVE (prosic verified NEW). b1_giving deferred it and asked James to decide whether it needs a slot; b1_polite separately dropped 'Poprosze o...' for the same reason. Both gave the same argument: o is already taught as a LOCATIVE governor (o_loc: mowie o pracy), so o + Accusative is a live homograph trap ON A FUNCTION WORD - which is exactly why it earns its own moment. The contrast (mowie o pracy vs prosze o kawe) IS the unit.

nodes.label: Idę, chodzę, jadę, jeżdżę
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 5. Closes the motion grid a2_chodzic left open. That pack fenced jezdzic so hard its own note says the word is 'not named, glossed, hinted at or used as a distractor anywhere in this file, note included'. Four verbs finally in one table: ide/chodze (on foot, now/habitually) x jade/jezdze (by vehicle, now/habitually). Only jezdze's forms are new; the four-way grid is the payoff.

nodes.label: Poszedłem, wszedłem
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 6 (spine O7.1). More prefixes on the owned motion stems: pojsc, wejsc, dojsc, przejsc and their -jechac partners. b1_arrive_leave taught only przy- and wy-; b1_wrapup's digest records poszedlem being caught and rejected during drafting as 'a THIRD prefix on isc's suppletive past stem beyond the two b1_arrive_leave actually taught'. Same treatment as b1_arrive_leave: the prefix welds onto a stem table the learner already has.

nodes.label: Pisać czy napisać?
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 7 (spine O7.2). A CLOSED SET of new aspect pairs, learned whole, NO RULE: pisac/napisac, gotowac/ugotowac, jesc/zjesc, placic/zaplacic, sprzatac/posprzatac (all perfectives verified NEW). Every imperfective member is already owned, so each pair costs one new word, not two. Pays a2_aspect's four-twins-only limit WITHOUT breaking its framing - that pack's own note says 'the prefixes are unpredictable... learn the pair whole, never build the second verb from the first', and this pack must restate that out loud. Productive semantic prefixation on non-motion verbs is C1.

nodes.label: Powinienem
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 6, unit 8. Modal completion, paying two a2_musiec fences ('past of musiec (musialem/musiala, trzeba bylo) - it would hand back the gender this unit just removed'; 'conditional powinienem' dropped). Teaches powinienem/powinnam/powinien/powinna (verified NEW - obligation carrying gender, unusual and worth naming) plus the past of the modals already owned: musialem/musiala, trzeba bylo, mozna bylo - straight applications of the past_ac rule owned since A2.

nodes.label: Czytanie, pisanie, gotowanie
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 7, unit 1. The -anie/-enie pattern. EXCEPTIONALLY WELL ANCHORED: check_new.py confirms pisanie, czytanie, plywanie, bieganie and spotkanie are ALREADY TAUGHT - as ordinary nouns, since A1. So the unit's whole idea is 'five words you already know are made from verbs you already know, and the pattern is regular.' Produces gotowanie, sprzatanie, mowienie, robienie (all verified NEW). Gender is uniformly neuter - a second gift, since it makes every one of them decline in a pattern already owned.

nodes.label: Otwarty, zamknięty, zrobiony
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 7, unit 2 (spine O4 - the B2/C1 participle fork). The passive adjectival participle, PREDICATE POSITION ONLY: zrobiony, napisany (NEW), anchored on otwarty/zamkniety, which check_new.py confirms are ALREADY TAUGHT as plain adjectives by leaf_shopping_a1. Agrees like any adjective - which Block 2 has just taught, so agreement costs nothing. FENCED TO C1: attributive/declined participles (w zamknietym sklepie), adverbial participles (robiac, zrobiwszy), the active adjectival participle (pracujacy).

nodes.label: Sklep jest zamknięty
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 7, unit 3 (spine O5). byc + participle: Sklep jest zamkniety. Praca jest zrobiona. Obiad byl ugotowany. ZERO new forms - the participles come from the unit before, byc is owned in all three tenses. FENCED TO C1: the zostac dynamic passive (Sklep zostal zamkniety) - zostac is an untaught verb with its own conjugation, so teaching it here would stack a new verb on a new construction.

nodes.label: Dworzec i hotel
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 8, unit 1. Situations/chunk unit (spine O12): checking in, the delayed train, the booked room. Genre of a2_directions_func / b1_polite. EVIDENCE FOR THE CHUNK-LANE CALL, not preference: of 16 obvious travel-logistics nouns run through check_new.py, TWELVE are already taught (lotnisko, peron, dworzec, bilet, przesiadka, opoznienie, bagaz, walizka, rezerwacja, odjazd, przyjazd, rozklad) - the gap in this domain is phrases, not words. Verified NEW and available: nocleg, odlot, przylot, wsiadac, wysiadac, potwierdzic, wazny, doba, plus opozniony/odwolany - which are PASSIVE PARTICIPLES, so this unit sits immediately after b2_participle_pass on purpose and gets them for free.

nodes.label: Rozmowa
nodes.label_en: Situations · taking part in a discussion
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 8, unit 2. Situations/chunk unit: agreeing, disagreeing politely, asking someone to expand, conceding a point. Recombines b1_opinions, b2_ze_clauses, b2_abstract and the conditional. Candidates verified NEW: uwazam, wydaje mi sie, zalezy, raczej, wlasnie, wedlug. Label uses 'rozmowa', taught earlier in B2 by b2_work - re-verify at wire time.

nodes.label: Siłownia · wszystko 2
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 8, unit 3. Gym idiom: ZERO new material, teaches_* empty. Extends b1_case_gym's eleven jobs with everything B2 added - adjective agreement in five cases, oblique pronouns, the three plural obliques. This board will be dense: split it across two intro slides rather than compressing, and log the call (b1_case_gym's own digest entry already flagged its eleven-job table as borderline for a review unit).

nodes.label: Praca, zdrowie, droga
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] Block 8, unit 4. B2 CAPSTONE, genre of a2_wrapup_func / b1_wrapup. Zero new material. Recombines the registers B2 added - work, health system, travel logistics, discussion - into mixed scenes. FOUR registers, matching b1_wrapup's own deliberate four-way limit; do not stack a fifth.

nodes.label: Stacja B2 · 2
nodes.note: [B2 SPINE] PLACEHOLDER - end-of-level exit-velocity bank. Stays 'planned' forever.
